opportunities.text: Marshall Space Flight Center payload operations and ISS science The Payload Operations Integration Center (POIC) in Huntsville, Alabama, manages the continuous flow of data and commands required to sustain orbital research. Last year, 750 investigations were performed aboard the International Space Station (ISS). These investigations depend on ground teams coordinating schedules and solving problems in real time to ensure the crew can maintain research momentum. The POIC operates 24 hours a day, seven days a week. The facility serves as a bridge between the crew on station and various global control centers.
